(() => { const v = document.querySelector('.dc-viewport'); const b = v.getBoundingClientRect(); const e = new WheelEvent('wheel', { deltaY: -100, clientX: b.left + b.width * 0.7, clientY: b.top + b.height * 0.6, ctrlKey: true, bubbles: true, cancelable: true }); v.dispatchEvent(e); v.dispatchEvent(new WheelEvent('wheel', { deltaY: -100, clientX: b.left + b.width * 0.7, clientY: b.top + b.height * 0.6, ctrlKey: true, bubbles: true, cancelable: true })); return '2D Ctrl+колесо: ' + document.querySelector('.dc-zoom-level').textContent + ' · ' + document.querySelector('.dc-zoomer').style.transform; })()

(() => { const v = document.querySelector('.dc-viewport'); const b = v.getBoundingClientRect(); v.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('dblclick', { clientX: b.left + b.width * 0.3, clientY: b.top + b.height * 0.4, bubbles: true, cancelable: true })); const s = document.querySelector('.dc-zoomer > svg').getBoundingClientRect(); return '2D во весь экран, двойной клик: ' + document.querySelector('.dc-zoom-level').textContent + ' · подсказка ' + document.querySelector('[data-hint]').textContent + ' · svg ' + Math.round(s.width) + '×' + Math.round(s.height) + ' · кнопка сдвига видна ' + (getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('[data-act=pan-mode]')).display !== 'none'); })()
